description: Single source of truth for the withdrawal circuit public/private inputs, byte layout, and artifact consumers. Any change here requires regenerating or re-validating all layers (.nr, Rust encode_public_inputs, TypeScript witness builder).

public_inputs.name: root
public_inputs.description: Merkle root; must be in PoolState.roots[] history.

public_inputs.name: nullifier_hash
public_inputs.description: hash_1(nullifier); used as PDA seed for NullifierRecord.

public_inputs.name: recipient
public_inputs.description: Solana Pubkey reduced modulo BN254 field prime. Must equal the recipient account passed to the instruction.

public_inputs.name: recipient_binding
public_inputs.description: hash_2(note_secret, recipient); binds the proof to a specific recipient, prevents front-running.

public_inputs.name: amount
public_inputs.description: Withdrawal amount in lamports. Padded to a full 32-byte field word: high 24 bytes zero, low 8 bytes big-endian u64.

private_inputs.name: nullifier
private_inputs.description: Secret nullifier; only the user knows it.

private_inputs.name: merkle_proof
private_inputs.description: Sibling hashes along the path from leaf to root.

private_inputs.name: is_even
private_inputs.description: For each level: true if our node is the left child, false if right.

constraints.description: Nullifier hash matches the public input.
Recipient binding matches the public input.

constraints.formula: compute_merkle_root(hash_3(nullifier, secret, amount), merkle_proof, is_even) == root
constraints.description: Commitment is in the tree with the given root.

hash_2.signature: fn hash_2(input1: Field, input2: Field) -> Field

hash_3.signature: fn hash_3(input1: Field, input2: Field, input3: Field) -> Field

hash_4.reason: Poseidon2 with t=4, rate=3, capacity=1. Using all 4 slots as input sets capacity=0 and destroys cryptographic security. hash_4 must never be used.

witness_layout.description: The byte layout of the witness blob passed to sunspot prove (and expected by the on-chain encode_public_inputs).

public_inputs_section.layout: 5 × 32 bytes, in the order defined in public_inputs[]

artifacts.description: Which JSON artifacts are produced from this circuit, and who consumes them.

prover.reason: Prover runs inside the solana container with access to circuits/.

merkle.reason: Merkle service is a Node.js process that may run outside the container.

web.reason: Frontend serves the ACIR to the browser for noir_js witness generation.

consumers_of_public_layout.obligation: pub parameters of main() must appear in the exact order of public_inputs[]
must produce bytes matching witness_layout exactly
must produce a witness blob matching witness_layout exactly
must send the proof and the 5 public inputs to the on-chain program in the order defined in public_inputs[]
